$comment: THE AGENT TOOL REVIEW. The crawler (scripts/agent-crawl.mjs) finds every function the app can call and
writes it to agent_tools switched off. A function is offered to the agent only when it is listed here with
enabled true and its signature still matches: a changed function is switched off until it is reviewed again.
Each change to this file is the diff that gets approved. Arguments the shop is (p_store_id) or the server
makes (p_client_uuid) are filled in by the gateway; hidden ones are never sent.

update_product.signature: p_product_id uuid, p_name text, p_sku text, p_barcode text, p_category_id uuid, p_list_price money_amt
update_product.title: Rename an item
update_product.description: Give an item a new name.

set_shape_price.title: Change a selling price
set_shape_price.description: Set the price of an item in one of the shapes it sells in (a crate, a pack, a bottle). Get the shape from item_shapes.

update_customer.title: Change a customer's name
update_customer.description: Change a customer's name, business name or notes.

update_customer_phone.title: Change a customer's phone number
update_customer_phone.description: Change a customer's phone number, for example from a contact they shared.
